targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  subtractSeconds(min(timestamp), 5) as time_from,
  addSeconds(max(timestamp), 5) as time_to
FROM
  profiling.timeseries
WHERE
  process_id == ${process_id}
  AND value_type == 'active_size'
  AND label_id == 0
;

WITH (
    SELECT
        argMaxMerge(peak_ts) as peak_ts
    FROM
        profiling.memory_peaks
    WHERE
        process_id == ${process_id}
        AND value_type == 'active_size'
) as max_rss
SELECT
    label || ':' || library || ':' || location as label,
    level,
    total_value as value,
    self_value as self,
    label_id
FROM 
(
    SELECT
        label_id,
        order_id,
        level,
        self_value,
        total_value
    FROM
        profiling.flamegraphs
    WHERE
        timestamp == max_rss
        AND process_id = ${process_id}
        AND value_type == 'active_size'
) as a
INNER JOIN 
(
    SELECT
        label_id,
        library,
        label,
        location
    FROM
        profiling.localized_name
    WHERE
        process_id = ${process_id}
) as b
ON (a.label_id == b.label_id)
ORDER BY (order_id)

WITH (
    SELECT
        argMaxMerge(peak_ts) as peak_ts
    FROM
        profiling.memory_peaks
    WHERE
        process_id == ${process_id}
        AND value_type == 'active_size'
) as max_rss
SELECT
    total_value,
    self_value,
    label,
    library,
    location
FROM (
    SELECT
        label_id,
        argMax(self_value, timestamp) as self_value,
        argMax(total_value, timestamp) as total_value
    FROM
        "profiling"."timeseries"
    WHERE 
        ( timestamp <= max_rss )
        AND ( process_id = $process_id )
        AND value_type = 'active_size'
    GROUP BY (label_id)
) as diffs
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT
        label_id,
        label,
        location,
        library
    FROM
        localized_name
    WHERE
        process_id = $process_id
) as names
ON diffs.label_id == names.label_id
ORDER BY total_value DESC

SELECT
    $__timeInterval(timestamp) as "time",
    max(total_value) as rss
FROM
    "profiling"."timeseries"
WHERE 
    $__timeFilter_ms(timestamp)
    AND ( process_id = $process_id )
    AND label_id = 0
    AND value_type = 'active_size'
GROUP BY ("time")
ORDER BY "time" ASC
;

SELECT
    $__timeInterval(timestamp) as "time",
    max(total_value) as active_allocations
FROM
    "profiling"."timeseries"
WHERE 
    $__timeFilter_ms(timestamp)
    AND ( process_id = $process_id )
    AND label_id = 0
    AND value_type = 'active_count'
GROUP BY ("time")
ORDER BY "time" ASC
;

SELECT 
    label || ':' || library || ':' || location as label,
    level,
    self_value as self,
    total_value as value
FROM
    executable(
        'flamegraph',
        TabSeparated,
        'order_id UInt32, label_id UInt32, level UInt32, total_value Int64, self_value Int64',
        (
            SELECT
                diff,
                path
            FROM (
                SELECT 
                    leaf_node_id,
                    right.active_size - ifNull(left.active_size, 0)  as diff
                FROM (
                    SELECT
                        leaf_node_id,
                        argMax(active_size, timestamp) as active_size
                    FROM
                        raw_data
                    WHERE
                        process_id == $process_id
                        AND timestamp <= $__toTime_ms
                    GROUP BY(leaf_node_id)
                ) AS right
                LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT
                        leaf_node_id,
                        argMax(active_size, timestamp) as active_size
                    FROM
                        raw_data
                    WHERE
                        process_id == $process_id
                        AND timestamp <= toDateTime64('${first_point_in_range}',9)
                    GROUP BY(leaf_node_id)
                ) as left
                USING (leaf_node_id)
                WHERE 
                    diff > 0 -- < 0
                ORDER BY diff DESC -- ASC
            ) as diff_values
            INNER JOIN (
                SELECT
                    leaf_node_id,
                    path
                FROM
                    stacktraces
                WHERE 
                    process_id == $process_id
            ) as st
            USING (leaf_node_id)
        )
    ) as a
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT
        label,
        library,
        location,
        label_id
    FROM
        localized_name
    WHERE
        process_id == $process_id
) as b
USING (label_id)
ORDER BY order_id ASC;

SELECT
    total_value_diff,
    self_value_diff,
    label,
    library,
    location
FROM (
    SELECT
        label_id,
        to.total_value - from.total_value as total_value_diff,
        to.self_value - from.self_value as self_value_diff
    FROM (
        SELECT
            label_id,
            argMax(self_value, timestamp) as self_value,
            argMax(total_value, timestamp) as total_value
        FROM
            "profiling"."timeseries"
        WHERE 
            ( timestamp <= $__toTime_ms )
            AND ( process_id = $process_id )
            AND value_type = 'active_size'
        GROUP BY (label_id)
    ) as to
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT
            label_id,
            argMax(self_value, timestamp) as self_value,
            argMax(total_value, timestamp) as total_value
        FROM
            "profiling"."timeseries"
        WHERE 
            ( timestamp <= toDateTime64('${first_point_in_range}',9))
            AND ( process_id = $process_id )
            AND value_type = 'active_size'
        GROUP BY (label_id)
    ) as from
    ON to.label_id == from.label_id
    WHERE total_value_diff != 0
) as diffs
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT
        label_id,
        label,
        location,
        library
    FROM
        localized_name
    WHERE
        process_id = $process_id
) as names
ON diffs.label_id == names.label_id
ORDER BY total_value_diff DESC

WITH (
SELECT
    arrayZip([${possible_functions:raw}], splitByString(' + ', '${possible_functions:text}')) as options
) as options
SELECT
    arrayFirst(x -> x.1 == label_id, options).2 as label,
    max(total_value) as value,
    $__timeInterval(timestamp) as time
FROM
    profiling.timeseries
WHERE
    $__timeFilter_ms(timestamp)
    AND process_id == ${process_id}
    AND label_id IN (${possible_functions:raw})
    AND value_type == 'active_size'
GROUP BY ("time", label)
ORDER BY "time" ASC
